title: CORE Business Event Envelope v1
description: Schema for a domain-neutral business event envelope derived from a state watcher. CORE validates the envelope; the fork interprets the payload.

event_type.description: Type of business event, matching the watcher's declared event_type.

source_watcher_id.description: The watcher_id that produced this event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the observation that triggered this event.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the event envelope for replay certification.

payload.description: Opaque domain-specific payload. CORE never interprets these fields.

previous_value.description: Previous observation value before the triggering observation.

observation_fixture_id.description: Fixture ID of the observation source.
